guide.s1: Open in Chrome or Safari (not inside Messenger / Viber / Instagram).
guide.s2: Create a room → enter your name and avatar → grant location & microphone permissions.
guide.s3: Share the PIN or the link with family / friends.
guide.s4: Members join with the PIN and appear on the map.
guide.s5: From the ⚡ Button you set SOS contacts, listening and check-in.
guide.s6: From Members → Edit map (admin only) you add pins and routes.
guide.s7: Add the app to your Home Screen for quick access and notifications.
